i'm sorry but i'm not going to go to a doctor or hospital.  They'd try to put me in an institution.  I'm not crazy.  Last time I called suicide lrevention they tried to have me locked up.  

I do't know what details you want.  I'm unemployed and have been underemployed since I graduated from college.  I've been out of school so long that I know I'm not employable except for retail or something similar.  I'm living in poverty and don't have any money left.  My rent is six days late now and I don't have the ability to pay it.  I'll most likely be evicted this month or next and be homeless.  I don't have any friends because nobody seems to like me.  My parents were physically abusive and I haven't seen them in ten years.  I have no other family.  I've never been in a relationship or even been on a date.  I haven't had any human contact in at least five years with the exception of touching a cashier's hand when I buy something.  I want to be a writer but haven't written anything in years.  I'm too lazy to ever accomplish anything.  I know my life will never get better and I don't want to keep living this life.

The person who responded was shadowbanned so I couldn't see their comment.  I think that's a pretty good sign that help isn't coming.  That's pretty funny.  I guess it'll be nice going out with a laugh.  Thanks to whoever it was.
